rules.title: Coordinates
rules.rule: A negative value's minus sign applies to the whole value: format the size of the value in feet and inches, then put '-' in front. -138 in prints -11'-6" (Rev 0 printed -12'-6", which a reader takes as -150 in); -6 in prints -6". This applies wherever a coordinate is printed (continuation blocks and end points).

rules.title: Weld labels
rules.rule: Label every weld exactly once, on the sheet that holds its position: the sheet whose two breaks (CONT'D ON / FROM points) bracket the weld's distance along the line. Never leave a weld dot without its label because of crowding; move the label or lengthen its leader instead. A weld close to a break is labelled only on its own sheet.

rules.title: Branch welds
rules.rule: A weld of a vent, drain, instrument or sample tap drawn on its parent line's sheets is labelled with its model tag's form {service}-{sequence}/W{n}: I-7001/W1 for the weld 3/4"-P300-I-7001/W1. Rev 0 continued the parent's numbering (W29, W30, ...), and those numbers do not exist in the model.

rules.title: FROM / TO labels
rules.rule: Print a FROM label at the start and a TO label at the end of every line whose end is an equipment nozzle ('TO P-101A NOZ. S'), a relief valve ('TO PSV', 'FROM PSV ON D-101 NOZ. N3') or a hose station ('TO HOSE STATION'). A tap end is shown by its CONT'D block, and a cap or blind by its symbol.

rules.title: Revision
rules.rule: Issue the corrected set as revision 1 of the same drawing numbers and sheet split: REV 1 in every title block and a revision row '1 <date> REVISED TO MATCH THE MODEL (FL-1)'. Change nothing else: the bills, pipe lengths, sheet breaks, title blocks and coverage already agree with the model.

rules.title: Licences
rules.rule: Make the revision with permissively licensed software and fonts only (for example MIT, BSD, Apache-2.0, ISC; fonts under a permissive font licence such as the Bitstream Vera licence of DejaVu Sans). No GPL, LGPL, AGPL, MPL or other copyleft program, library or font may be used to draw, render, combine or check the sheets. State the tools, versions and licences used on the cover page, as Rev 0 did. Use no published standard, table, catalogue or third-party drawing.

acceptance: A re-import here (python3 -I tools/isomatch.py import <parts>) reports 0 errors and 0 warnings.
The cover page names only permissively licensed tools and fonts (R6).
All 203 lines are covered; every bill, pipe length, title block and sheet break still agrees with the model.
The set reads with the usual sign convention (summary coordinateSign: conventional).
Every weld of every line and branch carries its model label once, on its own sheet.
